audited_source_corrections.action: Restored the statement that h is defined from f and g by primitive recursion before invoking the lemma that eliminates primitive recursion.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The cited lemma applies to the function h defined from f and g by primitive recursion, but the frozen sentence merely says h is defined from f and g and thus omits the construction being eliminated.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் h ஆனது f மற்றும் g இலிருந்து முதன்மை மீள்வரையறையால் வரையறுக்கப்படுகிறது என்பதை வெளிப்படையாக மீட்டமைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the construction unspecified; weakening the cited lemma into a false claim about every function definable from f and g.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding characterization and the cited primitive-recursion simulation lemma uniquely supply the omitted construction.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the sentence now state exactly which primitive-recursive construction is replaced by composition and regular minimization?

audited_source_corrections.action: Qualified the converse representability claim and the final comparison of axiomatizable theories by consistency.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: A computable derivation system alone does not ensure that every represented function is computable: an inconsistent axiomatizable theory proves every graph formula and its uniqueness clause, so every function becomes representable under the stated definition.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் விளக்கம் கணிக்கத்தக்க வருவித்தல் முறையுடன் முரணின்மையையும் கோருகிறது; இறுதி அடிகோளாக்கத்தக்க கோட்பாடுகள் பற்றிய கூற்றிலும் அதே தகுதியைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the overclaim; silently assuming consistency without stating it; redefining representability.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately preceding proof that representability yields computability explicitly uses consistency, and the standard examples Q, PA and ZF are intended under that same qualification.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both general claims now exclude inconsistent derivation systems while preserving the intended comparison across Q, PA and ZF?
